PDF fixtures generated with ReportLab 4.4.9 for import tests:

- `two-pages.pdf`: two pages of English text, a title and standard fonts.
- `chinese.pdf`: Chinese Unicode text with an embedded font subset.
- `blank-first.pdf`: a blank first page followed by text on page 2.
- `scanned.pdf`: graphics without any text layer, representing an image-only document.
- `encrypted.pdf`: password-protected text; password is `secret`.

The fixtures contain only synthetic test content. Runtime import uses PDF.js and does not require Python or Poppler.
